name: policy-sweep
description: Cross-policy comparison at a fixed context length. Every bounded policy is given the same 25% token budget so that a memory or latency difference is attributable to the policy, not to a different budget. The full-cache run is the reference: it is the only run that keeps all 512 tokens. Quality is measured on every run, because a memory saving that costs accuracy is not a saving. See docs/benchmarks.md for how to read these results and docs/research.md for what has actually been established so far.

runs.notes: reference: no eviction, no compression, no offload
reproduction of StreamingLLM-style window + attention sinks
pure recency eviction, attention signals deliberately unused
weighted blend of attention, recency, frequency and position
RESEARCH PROTOTYPE, not a validated method. Pressure-interpolated weights. A result here is a hypothesis, not a finding.
